terrain.model_basis: finite analytic box geoms; no wall and no heightfield

ablation.q_on_semantics: existing single-channel matched DOB Q-filter command enters the actuator sum path without an added gate or slew limiter

metrics.acceptance_basis: reuse applicable Stage 3 empty-platform limits; no composite score
metrics.velocity_RMSE_acceptance_window: steady constant-grade after the declared 1.0 s transition settling interval
